description: Explicitly reviewed cross-circuit public-input layout, wire encoding, domain binding, and derivation differences across silent_witness, redacted_ancestry, and selective_disclosure. Any unreviewed or drifted difference fails closed.

reviewed_differences.rationale: redacted_ancestry keeps unredacted parent media hash limbs private and binds them inside parent_commitment with parent_blinding so observers cannot correlate redacted derivatives to raw parent hashes.
silent_witness and selective_disclosure expose video_hash_hi directly as pub Field, whereas redacted_ancestry names the private opening parent_hash_hi and exposes parent_commitment:Field.

selective_disclosure prepends schema_hash, issuer_namespace, schema_version, credential_root, and nullifier before video_hash_hi at slot 5; silent_witness places video_hash_hi at slot 0; redacted_ancestry commits parent_commitment at slot 0.

hpx-vi enforces 16 leading zero bytes on silent_witness video_hash_hi, whereas selective_disclosure accepts a canonical BN254 field element without an in-circuit 128-bit range check and redacted_ancestry emits a 32-byte Pedersen commitment.
redacted_ancestry keeps parent_hash_lo private inside parent_commitment to protect unredacted parent media digests, while silent_witness and selective_disclosure publish video_hash_lo.
redacted_ancestry separates private parent_hash_lo from public parent_commitment rather than aliasing it to video_hash_lo.
silent_witness places video_hash_lo at slot 1, selective_disclosure places it at slot 6 after schema and identity headers, and redacted_ancestry folds parent_hash_lo into slot 0 parent_commitment.

silent_witness enforces 16 high zero bytes on video_hash_lo in hpx-vi, selective_disclosure treats video_hash_lo as a general canonical BN254 field, and redacted_ancestry exposes only the blinded Pedersen commitment.

redacted_ancestry intentionally omits a public credential_root and binds credential_secret only through its domain-separated nullifier so ancestry proofs remain unlinkable to static pseudonymous roots.
credential_root is declared as pub Field in silent_witness and selective_disclosure and omitted from redacted_ancestry.
silent_witness places credential_root after the two video hash limbs (slot 2), selective_disclosure places it after the three schema header fields (slot 3), and redacted_ancestry omits it.

silent_witness commits a single credential_secret while selective_disclosure commits a left-folded chain of blinded issuer-certified attributes; roots from the two circuits are distinct credential namespaces and must never be treated as interchangeable.

silent_witness enforces non-zero credential_root in the hpx-vi wire codec while allowing zero credential_secret in-circuit; redacted_ancestry asserts credential_secret != 0 in-circuit; selective_disclosure derives credential_root via Pedersen folding.

Each circuit's public frame orders statement-specific headers ahead of nullifier (slot 3 in silent_witness, slot 4 in selective_disclosure, slot 5 in redacted_ancestry); parsers dispatch by explicit schema rather than assuming a shared slot index.

silent_witness binds SCOPED_NULLIFIER_V1 via evidence_digest, redacted_ancestry binds HP_REDACT_NULLIFIER_V1 and ancestry_root, and selective_disclosure derives an deterministic per-evidence disclosure nullifier from credential_root, video hash limbs, and evidence_digest as documented in section 7.2 of the disclosure spec.

redacted_ancestry explicitly asserts nullifier != 0 in-circuit, silent_witness rejects zero nullifier at the hpx-vi wire boundary, and selective_disclosure constrains nullifier to a Pedersen output verified non-zero at registry ingestion.

silent_witness and redacted_ancestry expose domain_tag directly, whereas selective_disclosure binds context through public schema_hash, issuer_namespace, circuit_version, and non-zero verifier_digest.
domain_tag is declared as pub Field in silent_witness and redacted_ancestry and omitted in selective_disclosure.
silent_witness places domain_tag at slot 6 ahead of the trailing circuit_version slot 7, redacted_ancestry places domain_tag as its final slot 7, and selective_disclosure omits domain_tag.
silent_witness and redacted_ancestry share harpocrates_common::expected_domain_tag(), while selective_disclosure hashes verifier_digest, schema_hash, and circuit_version.
Tracks the documented transition between the SHA-256 wire domain tag in hpx-vi and the Pedersen expected_domain_tag() in Noir source alongside selective_disclosure's verifier_digest != 0 check.
silent_witness and selective_disclosure carry an explicit circuit_version public input slot, whereas redacted_ancestry binds CIRCUIT_VERSION inside the Pedersen preimage of public ancestry_root.
redacted_ancestry folds CIRCUIT_VERSION into ancestry_root instead of declaring a standalone circuit_version: pub Field parameter.

silent_witness places circuit_version as its trailing 8th field (slot 7), selective_disclosure places circuit_version at slot 8 before evidence_digest and predicate_commitment, and redacted_ancestry omits the standalone slot.

Each circuit evolves its own version counter independently (silent_witness at v2 u32, selective_disclosure at v1 u32, redacted_ancestry at v1 Field) without coercing constant names or Noir integer/Field types.

hpx-vi/2 rejects non-zero upper 28 bytes on silent_witness circuit_version (sw2-neg-024-dirty-upper), selective_disclosure parses low 4 bytes while asserting field equality in-circuit, and redacted_ancestry commits CIRCUIT_VERSION inside ancestry_root.

selective_disclosure asserts circuit_version == CURRENT_CIRCUIT_VERSION in main(), redacted_ancestry binds CIRCUIT_VERSION inside derive_ancestry_root(), and silent_witness currently enforces circuit_version == 2 at the hpx-vi/2 codec and registry boundary.

silent_witness derives evidence_digest internally from DIGEST_ALGORITHM_SHA256, video_hash limbs, and scope_hash; selective_disclosure takes evidence_digest as a public input slot; redacted_ancestry exposes derivative_digest and parameters_digest.
Only selective_disclosure declares evidence_digest: pub Field directly on main().
selective_disclosure places evidence_digest at slot 9, while silent_witness keeps evidence_digest internal and redacted_ancestry uses slots 1 and 2 for derivative_digest and parameters_digest.
